subject: astronomy
title: Telescopes: Foundations
welcome_lead: A telescope gathers more light than your eye — and shows you the universe.
meta_desc: KS3 astronomy: refractor, reflector, lenses and mirrors.
final_note: Bigger lens or mirror means dimmer things become visible.

concepts.def: Tool that gathers light to see far objects.
Diameter of the main lens or mirror.

walkthroughs.body_html: A refractor uses a big lens at the front. Light bends through the lens and meets at an eyepiece. Galileo used one to see Jupiter's moons.
A reflector uses a curved mirror at the back. Mirrors can be made huge and cheap, so big professional telescopes are reflectors.
A bigger aperture gathers more light. That means you can see fainter stars and finer detail.
